meta.subject: English
meta.topic: Activity 2 of 9 (quiz/game): Guided Fill-In - Rhetorical Grammar
meta.title: Guided Fill-In: Rhetorical Grammar Bingo

questions.prompt: Which word best fills the blank to create a cumulative sentence that adds modifying details after the main clause? The hikers reached the summit, ___.
questions.explanation: The phrase exhausted but triumphant attaches to the end of the independent clause as a modifier, creating a cumulative sentence structure.

questions.prompt: Which transition word best fills the blank to signal a contrast between two independent clauses? The data supported the hypothesis; ___, the conclusion remained uncertain.
questions.explanation: The word however signals a rhetorical contrast between the supporting data and the uncertain conclusion.

questions.prompt: Which verb form correctly completes the subjunctive mood for rhetorical effect? The principal demanded that every student ___ present for the assembly.
questions.explanation: The base form be is required in the subjunctive mood following a verb of demand to express necessity rather than fact.

questions.prompt: Which punctuation mark correctly fills the blank to set off an interrupting phrase that provides extra detail? The old bridge ___ a landmark since 1920 ___ was finally closed for repairs.
questions.explanation: Commas correctly set off the nonrestrictive appositive phrase a landmark since 1920 without breaking the main clause.

questions.prompt: Which word best fills the blank to create parallel structure? The mayor promised to lower taxes, to fix roads, and ___ schools.
questions.explanation: The infinitive phrase to fund matches the grammatical pattern established by to lower and to fix earlier in the list.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with an infinitive phrase: Rewrite the instructions ___ so that no student makes the same mistake twice.
questions.explanation: To avoid mistakes is an infinitive phrase that expresses the purpose of rewriting the instructions.

questions.prompt: Which completion creates emphatic inversion for rhetorical effect? Only after the alarm sounded ___.
choices: returned the firefighters to the station
the firefighters did return to the station
did the firefighters return to the station
had the firefighters return to the station
questions.explanation: Placing did before the subject creates emphatic inversion after the opening phrase Only after the alarm sounded.

questions.prompt: Select the verb form that expresses a contrary‑to‑fact condition in the subjunctive mood: If the proposal ___ approved, the project would begin next month.
questions.explanation: The subjunctive 'were' is used for hypothetical conditions regardless of the subject.

questions.prompt: Which adjective best fills the blank to create an oxymoron by pairing contradictory terms? The room fell into a ___ hush.
questions.explanation: The phrase deafening hush is an oxymoron because deafening suggests loudness while hush suggests silence.

questions.prompt: Which completion uses parataxis by placing three independent clauses side by side with equal emphasis? The ambassador pledged three goals: ___.
choices: We will listen, because we will act, and we will adapt.
We will listen; we will act; we will adapt.
Although we will listen, we will act, and we will adapt.
When we listen, we will act, and we will adapt.
questions.explanation: The semicolons join three independent clauses in a balanced sequence without making any clause grammatically subordinate to another.

questions.prompt: Which completion most clearly uses hyperbole to exaggerate the storm's effect? The trees bent, and ___.
choices: the porch light flickered for several minutes
the whole neighborhood vanished beneath a wall of wind
the strongest branches broke near the house
the rain drummed steadily against the roof
questions.explanation: The claim that the entire neighborhood vanished deliberately overstates the storm's effect and therefore creates hyperbole.

questions.prompt: Which word best fills the blank to create a tricolon of three parallel adjectives? The evidence was clear, consistent, and ___.
questions.explanation: Compelling is an adjective that completes the series of three parallel adjectives describing the evidence.

questions.prompt: Which verb form correctly fills the blank to maintain parallel structure in a series of infinitives? The committee voted to expand the program, to hire additional staff, and ___ community outreach.
questions.explanation: To increase matches the preceding infinitives to expand and to hire, preserving grammatical parallelism.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence to illustrate polysyndeton by using a conjunction before each item: The recipe calls for flour and sugar and eggs and ___.
questions.explanation: Polysyndeton repeats the conjunction “and” before every element, so the final item should appear without an extra conjunction.

questions.prompt: Which transition word best fills the blank to signal a concession before the main argument? The project requires significant funding; ___, its potential benefits justify the expense.
questions.explanation: Admittedly signals a concession by acknowledging the cost before the writer pivots to the benefits.

questions.prompt: Which conjunction best fills the blank to emphasize a surprising contrast between two clauses? The storm caused widespread damage, ___ the town rebuilt its infrastructure within a month.
questions.explanation: The conjunction yet introduces a contrasting idea that highlights the unexpected speed of the town's recovery.

questions.prompt: Which verb form correctly fills the blank to maintain parallel structure in a series of present participles? The volunteers spent the afternoon planting trees, painting fences, and ___ trails.
questions.explanation: The present participle clearing matches the grammatical form of planting and painting to complete the parallel series.

questions.prompt: Which word best fills the blank to create a parallel series of past participles? The document was written, edited, and ___ by noon.
questions.explanation: The word published maintains the parallel series of past participles established by written and edited.

questions.prompt: Which completion uses an absolute phrase to add descriptive detail to the main clause? The crowd cheered wildly, ___.
choices: their voices echoing through the stadium
as their voices echoed through the stadium
and their voices echoed through the stadium
because their voices echoed through the stadium
questions.explanation: The phrase their voices echoing through the stadium is an absolute phrase that modifies the entire main clause without using a conjunction or relative pronoun.

questions.prompt: Which transition word best fills the blank to show a cause-and-effect relationship? The river flooded its banks; ___, several roads were closed for days. (A) consequently (B) nevertheless (C) meanwhile (D) alternatively
questions.explanation: Consequently signals that the road closures resulted directly from the flooding.

questions.prompt: Which transition word best fills the blank to concede a point before presenting a counterargument? The initial cost is high; ___, the long-term savings are substantial.
questions.explanation: Nevertheless signals a concession followed by a contrasting point, which strengthens the rhetorical impact of the argument.

questions.prompt: Which completion uses litotes by affirming a quality while denying its opposite? The student's final essay was ___.
questions.explanation: The phrase far from mediocre uses litotes by suggesting excellent work through understated denial of mediocrity.

questions.prompt: Complete the antanaclasis by using the same word twice with different meanings: We must ___ the watch.
questions.explanation: Antanaclasis repeats a word in two senses, so the verb “watch” serves both as “to look at” and “the timepiece”.

questions.prompt: Which verb form correctly fills the blank to maintain consistent tense throughout the sentence? She analyzed the data carefully and ___ her findings to the board.
questions.explanation: Presented maintains the past tense established by analyzed, ensuring grammatical consistency across the compound predicate.

questions.prompt: Select the auxiliary verb that produces the correct inverted order after the negative adverb: Rarely ___ the committee reach a unanimous decision.
questions.explanation: After a fronted negative adverb such as 'Rarely,' the auxiliary 'does' inverts with the subject.

questions.prompt: Which completion gives the deadline in the most precise, formal wording? The deadline is ___.
questions.explanation: Friday at five o'clock states the exact day and time, so it uses more precise diction than vague time expressions.

questions.prompt: Which relative pronoun best fills the blank? Ms. Ortiz praised the student ___ had won the scholarship.
questions.explanation: Who correctly refers to the student and serves as the subject of the clause had won the scholarship.

questions.prompt: Which paragraph opening repeats the same phrase at the beginning of successive sentences to create emphasis?
choices: A scientist tested the claim. A reviewer repeated the test. A judge accepted the result.
The experts must be listened to. Their claims must be tested. Their advice must be followed.
Listen to the experts. Test their claims. Act on what survives.
We must listen to experts. We must test their claims. We must act on what survives.
questions.explanation: Beginning successive sentences with We must creates anaphora, the repetition of a phrase across neighboring sentences.

questions.prompt: Choose the noun phrase that maintains parallelism in the series: The plan covers funding for research, ___ , and outreach.
questions.explanation: The series requires parallel noun phrases, so 'curriculum development' matches 'funding for research' and 'outreach'.

questions.prompt: Which completion uses verbal irony by saying the opposite of what the situation suggests? After losing the championship, the player said, “What a ___.”
questions.explanation: Calling the loss a great day expresses the opposite of the player's expected feelings and therefore creates verbal irony.

questions.prompt: Which word best fills the blank to create a parallel series of gerunds? The program focuses on recruiting volunteers, training leaders, and ___ resources. (A) managing (B) management (C) to manage (D) manages
questions.explanation: The gerund managing continues the parallel pattern established by recruiting and training.

questions.prompt: Which phrase best fills the blank to add an appositive that renames the subject? Dr. Evans, ___, delivered the keynote address at the conference. (A) a renowned biologist (B) studying biology (C) who is renowned (D) biologically renowned
questions.explanation: The noun phrase a renowned biologist functions as an appositive that identifies Dr. Evans.

questions.prompt: Which word best fills the blank to create a parallel series of nouns? The speech appealed to our reason, our emotions, and our ___.
questions.explanation: The noun values maintains parallel structure with the preceding nouns reason and emotions.

questions.prompt: Which conjunction best fills the blank to emphasize addition rather than contrast? The new policy reduces waste, ___ it lowers operating costs significantly. (A) and (B) but (C) or (D) so
questions.explanation: The conjunction and links the two benefits together to build a cumulative persuasive argument.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses antithesis to place two ideas in deliberate contrast?
choices: The data supports the board's recommendation.
Either we unite and act, or we divide and wait.
Please turn off every light before you leave the room.
The committee should publish its report next Wednesday morning.
questions.explanation: The sentence sets unite and divide, and act and wait, in direct contrast, which creates antithesis.

questions.prompt: Which completion creates a cleft sentence that emphasizes the person who proposed the park? ___ the mayor who proposed the new park.
questions.explanation: The It was construction forms a cleft sentence that emphasizes the mayor as the person who proposed the park.

questions.prompt: Which punctuation mark correctly fills the blank to set off a parenthetical element for rhetorical emphasis? The new policy ___ a measure debated for years ___ finally passed the senate.
questions.explanation: Em dashes set off the parenthetical phrase with stronger rhetorical emphasis than commas would provide.

questions.prompt: The essay supports its claim with statistics, clearly explained cause and effect, and a comparison of relevant evidence. Which rhetorical appeal does this primarily use?
questions.explanation: Logos is an appeal to logic, and the statistics, explanations, and comparisons support the claim through reasoning.

questions.prompt: Which verb form correctly completes the sentence using parallel infinitives? The coach urged the players to stretch before practice, to hydrate during breaks, and ___ after games. (A) to rest (B) resting (C) rested (D) rest
questions.explanation: The infinitive to rest matches the structure of to stretch and to hydrate earlier in the sentence.

questions.prompt: Which phrase best fills the blank to complete an antithetical balance? We seek not comfort in silence, but ___.
questions.explanation: The phrase courage in action creates a rhetorical antithesis by contrasting directly with comfort in silence.

questions.prompt: Which sentence asks a rhetorical question intended to make the audience think rather than to request information?
choices: What time does the library close on Saturday evening?
Where will the committee meet for its final review?
If we protect our neighborhoods today, will we not build a safer tomorrow?
How many pages does the final report contain?
questions.explanation: The negative question invites the audience to recognize that acting now can create a better future.

questions.prompt: Which verb form correctly fills the blank to maintain consistent tense in a narrative sentence? She reviewed the proposal carefully and ___ her objections to the board.
questions.explanation: The past tense verb voiced maintains consistent tense alongside the earlier verb reviewed.

questions.prompt: Choose the correlative conjunction that correctly completes the sentence: Not only did the speaker address the budget, ___ she also proposed a timeline.
questions.explanation: The pair 'not only … but also' creates a balanced, emphatic structure.

questions.prompt: Which punctuation mark correctly fills the blank to join two closely related independent clauses without a conjunction? The experiment yielded unexpected results ___ the team decided to repeat the trial. (A) ; (B) , (C) : (D) -
questions.explanation: A semicolon properly connects two independent clauses that share a close logical relationship.

questions.prompt: Which completion creates understatement by making the amount of work sound smaller than it was? After spending six hours revising the difficult essay, the writer called the final task ___.
questions.explanation: Calling six hours of revision a quick touch-up deliberately minimizes the work involved.

questions.prompt: Which word best completes the sentence as a predicate adjective? The results seem ___ after months of testing.
questions.explanation: Surprising is a predicate adjective that describes the results after the linking verb seem.

questions.prompt: Which conjunction creates the strongest rhetorical contrast in this sentence? The proposal was inexpensive, ___ it failed to address the core issue.
questions.explanation: The conjunction yet introduces a sharp contrast between the low cost of the proposal and its failure to solve the main problem.

questions.prompt: Which transition word best fills the blank to show that the second clause adds support to the first? The study confirmed earlier findings; ___, it introduced new variables for future research.
questions.explanation: The transition moreover signals that the second independent clause adds further support to the claim made in the first.

questions.prompt: Which punctuation mark correctly fills the blank to introduce a clarifying list at the end of the sentence? The recipe requires three ingredients: flour, sugar, ___ eggs.
questions.explanation: The conjunction and is required before the final item in a series to complete the list grammatically.

questions.prompt: Which phrase completes the sentence to create a tricolon that builds in intensity? We must plan carefully, act boldly, and ___.
questions.explanation: The phrase succeed completely finishes the three-part structure by moving from planning to acting to achieving with increasing force.

feedback.correct: Nice fill-in — that grammatical choice lands exactly where it should.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite — compare the options' grammar and effect, then try again.
feedback.win: Bingo! You filled the board by filling in the blanks like a rhetorician.
feedback.lose: The board filled against you, but every blank you missed is now a blank you understand.

rejected.prompt: Which sentence reverses corresponding elements in an A-B-B-A order?
choices: The coach praised effort, and effort earned the coach's respect.
The visitors enjoyed the exhibit, and the exhibit appealed to the visitors.
